title: HILLS BANCORPORATION 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Hills Bancorporation, a small regional bank holding company based in Hills, Iowa, filed a Form 8-K announcing the retirement of three directors—Michael E. Hodge, Ann Marie Rhodes, and Thomas R. Wiele—from its Board of Directors on April 20, 2026. The retirements were made in accordance with the company's board retirement policy requiring director departure at age 72 following the Annual Meeting. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Hills Bancorporation is a small Iowa-chartered bank holding company (Commission File Number: 0-12668; I.R.S. EIN: 42-1208067).
Three directors retired on April 20, 2026: Michael E. Hodge, Ann Marie Rhodes, and Thomas R. Wiele.
Retirements were pursuant to the Board of Directors' policy mandating retirement at age 72 following the Annual Meeting.
The filing was signed by Lisa A. Shileny, Director, President and Chief Executive Officer, on April 24, 2026.
This is a routine SEC Form 8-K filing under Item 5.02 (Departure of Directors).
